title: Rate limiter
skill: State the units and the limits

good: In src/limits/bucket.js, createBucket({ capacity, refillPerSec, now }) refill() adds (t - last) * refillPerSec, but now() returns ms and refillPerSec is per second, so it refills 1000x too fast. It also has no cap, and allow() lets a request through with less than one token. Rules: add ((t - last) / 1000) * refillPerSec; cap tokens at capacity; allow() takes one token and returns true only when tokens >= 1, else returns false and takes nothing. Keep part tokens so small waits add up. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: The rate limiter lets too many requests through. Fix it.
